_why: Every FlowWorks and Gimme Some Slack (GSS) item belongs to the seat in `seat`: BENCH, where Relentless builds, proves and accepts it (FOUNDRY retired 2026-11-02, owner by card "What should happen to FOUNDRY? -> Retire it"); an item that needs the owner live (needs=owner) stays the Conductor's. rimflow reads this file in `file` (a FlowWorks id filed for another seat is filed for `seat`) and in `acceptance` (a FlowWorks item is swept by `seat` at every level). Match is on the item ID; add a pattern when a FlowWorks item slips through.
